form.label: BSL - Account Baseline
form.description: Advanced Windows Event Log analysis with security focus and detailed logon tracking

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | stats count by computer_name | sort computer_name

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats dc(new_logon_account_name) as unique_users

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 NOT new_logon_account_name IN ("-", "SYSTEM", "ANONYMOUS LOGON", "*$", "*SERVICE") | stats dc(new_logon_account_name) AS user_accounts

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 new_logon_account_name IN ("*SERVICE") | stats dc(new_logon_account_name) AS service_accounts

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats dc(new_logon_account_name) as unique_users

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats dc(new_logon_account_name) as unique_users

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 | eval logon_description=case( logon_type=="2", "Interactive (2)", logon_type=="3", "Network (3)", logon_type=="4", "Batch (4)", logon_type=="5", "Service (5)", logon_type=="7", "Unlock (7)", logon_type=="8", "Network Cleartext (8)", logon_type=="9", "New Credentials (9)", logon_type=="10", "Remote Interactive (10)", logon_type=="11", "Cached Interactive (11)", true(), "Other (" + logon_type + ")" ) | stats count by logon_description | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "Detailed Authentication Information:.*?Authentication Package:\\\\t(?<authentication_package>[^\\\\n]+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 authentication_package!="-" | stats count by authentication_package | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ (event_id=4624 OR event_id=4625) | eval event_type=case( event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="2", "Interactive", event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="3", "Network", event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="10", "RDP", event_id=="4624", "Other Logon Type", event_id=="4625", "Failed Logon", true(), "Other" ) | stats count by _time, computer_name, new_logon_account_name, event_type | table _time, computer_name, new_logon_account_name, event_type | sort -_time

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ (event_id=4624 OR event_id=4625) | eval event_type=case( event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="2", "Interactive", event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="3", "Network", event_id=="4624" AND logon_type=="10", "RDP", event_id=="4624", "Other Success", event_id=="4625", "Failed Logon", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by event_type

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "Network Information:.*?Source Network Address:\\\\t(?<source_network_address>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 logon_type="3" source_network_address!="-" source_network_address!="127.0.0.1" | stats count by source_network_address | sort -count | head 15

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "Network Information:.*?Source Network Address:\\\\t(?<source_network_address>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4624 logon_type="3" source_network_address!="-" source_network_address!="127.0.0.1" | stats count by source_network_address | sort -count | head 15

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" message=$stringtoken$ | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "Account For Which Logon Failed:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<failed_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Network Information:.*?Source Network Address:\\\\t\\\\t(?<source_network_address>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Failure Information:.*?Failure Reason:\\\\t\\\\t(?<failure_reason>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Failure Information:.*?Status:\\\\t\\\\t(?<failure_status>[^\\\\n]+)" | search computer_name=$hostFilter$ event_id=4625 failed_account_name!="-" | stats count, values(failure_reason) as reasons, values(source_network_address) as source_ips by failed_account_name, computer_name | sort -count
